g.text: Deterministic-First Analysis · Schema-Enforced AI Reasoning · Transactional Persist-then-Publish
Repo code is treated as DATA,
• No diff fetch or LLM calls on ingress path (T-10)
• Repository content is input data, never authority
• ESLint + Semgrep AST findings are authoritative
• LLM findings are deltas on top of grounded rules
• Model output validated against contracts Zod schemas
• Durable PostgreSQL write before GitHub API call
• Unanchored findings safely demoted to body comment
